title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Using Flow Matching on Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.19801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial anomaly detection often relies on large unlabeled transaction logs, where anomalous samples may already be present during training. Such training-set contamination violates the clean-normal data assumption underlying many anomaly detection methods. Although flow matching has demonstrated strong performance in generative modeling, its robustness in unsupervised tabular anomaly detection remains underexplored. In this work, we study flow-matching-based anomaly detection under contaminated training data by comparing Time-Conditioned Contraction Matching (TCCM) with Forest-Flow and evaluating multiple anomaly scoring functions. Our results show that the choice of anomaly score is critical. The original single-step Decision score used by TCCM is sensitive to contamination, whereas trajectory-based Deviation and Reconstruction scores provide more stable anomaly signals. translated_title: 基于流匹配的无监督表格数据异常检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19801v1 公告类型：新 摘要：金融异常检测通常依赖于大量未标记的交易日志，其中在训练过程中可能已经存在异常样本。这种训练集污染违反了支撑许多异常检测方法的干净正常数据假设。尽管流匹配在生成建模中展示了强大的性能，但其在无监督表格异常检测中的鲁棒性仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们通过比较时间条件收缩匹配（TCCM）与森林流，并评估多种异常评分函数，研究了在污染训练数据下基于流匹配的异常检测。我们的结果表明，异常评分的选择至关重要。TCCM使用的原始单步决策评分对污染敏感，而基于轨迹的偏差和重建评分提供了更稳定的异常信号。使用这些评分，森林流变得具有竞争力，并且在某些情况下优于其他方法。
tldr: 本研究揭示了在训练数据受污染的情况下，基于流匹配的异常检测性能高度依赖于异常评分函数的选择，其中基于轨迹的评分比单步决策评分更稳健，使得森林流方法在表格数据异常检测中表现优异。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that in flow-matching-based anomaly detection under contaminated training data, performance heavily depends on the choice of anomaly scoring function, with trajectory-based scores being more robust than single-step decision scores, making Forest-Flow competitive in tabular anomaly detection.
